name: Cruel Nobility
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Cruel Nobility

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Axiomatic Burst
effects.tooltip: Axiomatic Burst 4 : This weapon is an implement of law, dealing 4d6 Law damage on a successful hit to Chaotic enemies, and 9d6 Law damage on a critical hit to Chaotic enemies. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned. Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.

effects.name: Evil Blast
effects.tooltip: Evil Blast 4 : This weapon is a sinister implement of evil deeds, dealing 4d6 Evil damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Evil damage on a critical hit. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned. Good characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.tooltip: Bleeding 4 : This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 4d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.

effects.name: Disintegration
effects.tooltip: Disintegration : This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.

flavor_text: A finely wrought scimitar that once belonged to a Rakshasa noble, glowing darkly with an unholy aura. It tears into enemies viciously and is especially debilitating against those whose hearts are not evil
tips: Grants two negative levels on a Chaotic Good character.

source.raw: The Lords of Dust , Tahmael 's chest
